_readme.obsidian: 1.15.0 (window title; user agent obsidian/1.13.7, the installer build), Electron 43.1.0, run in a private headless sway session (WLR_BACKENDS=headless, XWayland) with USER_DATA_DIR=/tmp/claude-1000/scoria-probe-udd-composer, CDP_PORT=9241
_readme.keys: Each top-level key is one run: SCEN, plus ':'+ONLY when a subset ran. Every run had a fresh scratch vault.

superseded.settings: s01-tab-zk-prefixer: the template picker did not open after the Note composer tab's picker in the same session; use settings:s01-tab-zk for that tab
superseded.settings:s00|s01: the picker was clicked at its rect only, which lands on the empty tab behind Settings; superseded
superseded.settings:s01-tab-note: fallback experiments for the picker; superseded by settings:s01
superseded.settings:s01: zk picker failed to open (see above); its Note composer tab is good
superseded.merge: first full pass: s08-links raised 'Update links', the step closed it with its x, and every later merge (s09 to s13) hung behind the Merge button's mod-loading; s10/s11 Ctrl+Enter had no suggestion to act on and created nothing. s00-s07 are good and were re-run in merge:^s0[0-7]
superseded.merge:^s(00|18|19): s18 failed on a quoting bug; re-run in merge:^s(00|18|19c)
superseded.split: s06-s10 used headings whose names fuzzy-matched existing files (Enter then picked that file, not a new note) and carets off the heading line; re-run in split:^s(00|02-folder-folder|0[6-9]|10|20). Its s02-folder-folder is the case of a newFileFolderPath that does not exist
superseded.zk: s05-s07 ran a wrong command id (zk-prefixer:insert-unique-link); s04 had no Zettel folder; re-run in zk:^s(00|04|05|06|07|08|09). Its leaf counts used iterateRootLeaves, which missed a new tab: see zk:^s(00|01|02|04d)
superseded.random2: re-run after the leaf-count fix (getLeavesOfType + tab headers); the earlier copy was overwritten
